incident.observedStage: account lookup or account/workspace creation transaction, not session creation

existingWebLogin: USAGE on the new dedicated registration schema only
EXECUTE on its one fixed register function only
proposedGrantDelta.newDefiner: One dedicated NOLOGIN, NOINHERIT, NOBYPASSRLS role with no other role memberships or elevated attributes; owns only the new function/schema, not the business tables.

functionBoundary: One fixed SECURITY DEFINER routine, fixed search_path with pg_catalog first and pg_temp last, qualified business tables, no dynamic SQL or caller-provided IDs, status, role, or admin bit.
Bound privately to one exact normalized test email fingerprint; fixed workspace name. Do not publish the email, its identifying derivations, or password material. This is not email verification.

Derive the same stable user/workspace/membership IDs as the existing application. Only accept the existing application-produced PBKDF2 hash and salt with expected formats, never a plaintext password or arbitrary password iteration count.

Four inserts in the same transaction: ordinary active non-admin user, one active unconfigured and unprovisioned workspace owned by that user, one Owner membership, one credential. Reject existing identity; no adoption, UPDATE, UPSERT, READ of other business rows, or partial commit.

Return only the exact newly created ID required by the existing registration handler; existing post-commit session handling and its already-disclosed expired-session cleanup remain separate and unchanged. No purchases, dispatch or deployment.

approvalGates.offlineImplementationAndDisposablePostgr: Separate approval to add only the reviewed routine and one sandbox registration adapter call; no production access.
approvalGates.catalogPreflight: Separately approve an exact read-only database identity/effective privileges, schema/FK/RLS, role/name and one test identity existence check. If the live path does not match or the user already exists, stop rather than adding grants or issuing a new signup.
approvalGates.sqlInstallation: Separate approval for exact scope and SHA, one explicit DDL transaction, independent catalog verification; no registration call or test DML against the live database.
approvalGates.platformRelease: Separate approval for the pinned platform source/image and exact original closed-controller service only. Keep current database Secret and all existing login/session/worker/cloud permissions unchanged. No other stack or database restoration.
approvalGates.personalRetry: Only after SQL and platform verification and an exact unused identity are independently confirmed, approve a single personal attempt. If the response is ambiguous, do not retry or delete data automatically.
